intent: Connect task ownership, conflict prevention and agent communication during development.
core_changes: Atomic dependency-aware task claims and path leases
Claim fencing, workspace/branch binding and concrete-path guards
Bounded wait and task conversation channels over CLI/MCP
Nested transaction and same-label conflict fixes
contracts: Additive task lifecycle events and MCP tools; maintainer review required
tests: Independent MCP process integration across Git worktrees
Full source/wheel suites and JSON/schema/skill validation
risks: Cooperative local coordination does not intercept arbitrary file writes
Task completion is self-reported, not independent review approval
Client brands are routing labels, not authenticated identities
MCP wait is bounded and synchronous, not native model wakeup
